name: Bartleby
summary: At the Pig and Whistle Tavern, Bartleby drinks and picks fights in Stormwind's Old Town. His stubborn grip on his ale makes him a test for aspiring warriors, who must face him in a tavern brawl.

sections.title: A Fixture at the Pig and Whistle
sections.body: Bartleby spends his days at the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Stormwind's Old Town. Its crowd runs rougher than the taprooms of Cathedral Square. He clings to his favorite mug, drinks cheap ale, nurses grievances, and picks fights with anyone who disturbs him.

sections.title: A Warrior's Rite of Passage
sections.body: Stormwind's warrior trainers make a practical test of Bartleby. Harry Burlguard sends fledgling fighters to find him and take his mug. They trade bare-knuckle blows with the intoxicated brawler, proving they have the grit to face an unruly opponent at close quarters.

faq.answer: Bartleby is an unruly patron of the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Stormwind's Old Town. He gets thoroughly intoxicated and refuses to give up his mug without a fistfight.
You can find Bartleby drinking on the ground floor of the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Stormwind's Old Town.

faq.q: Why do warriors need to fight him?
faq.answer: Harry Burlguard, a warrior trainer in Old Town, sends young recruits to Bartleby to test their combat ability. Taking his mug by force shows they can handle a sudden brawl and tough opposition.

faq.q: What happens when you confront him?
faq.answer: When challenged for his mug, Bartleby drinks a potion to bolster his fortitude and turns hostile. He brawls unarmed in the tavern until beaten into submission.

faq.q: Does Bartleby belong to any faction or organization?
faq.answer: Bartleby is a civilian of Stormwind and a habitual drunkard. He has no known ties to the Defias Brotherhood or the city guard.

faq.q: Why won't he just hand over his mug?
faq.answer: Bartleby is belligerent, heavily intoxicated, and obstinate. He treats requests for his drink or mug as insults and would rather settle matters with his fists than part with his booze.

angles.text: As a young warrior in Stormwind, you remember your duel with Bartleby. Taking the stubborn drunk's mug makes a memorable test of hand-to-hand combat.
As a human, you see the gritty, working-class side of Stormwind's Old Town, where local disputes are settled over overturned barstools rather than royal decree.
